title: Vitória de Guimarães vs. Casa Pia: Crisis Clash in Liga Portugal
seoTitle: Vitória vs Casa Pia: Liga Portugal Crisis Clash
subtitle: The match that could turn the tide for two struggling sides
excerpt: Vitória de Guimarães hosts Casa Pia in Guimarães for a match marked by attacking woes and fragile defenses.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between Vitória de Guimarães and Casa Pia, scheduled for 2:00 PM on September 6, 2026, is drawing attention as both clubs navigate delicate moments this season. While Vitória sits in 12th place with just one win in four matches, Casa Pia remains at the bottom of the table, having failed to score while conceding 11 goals.

Vitória de Guimarães looking for momentum

Vitória, managed by Tiago Margarido, comes off three consecutive defeats and needs a positive result at the Estádio D. Afonso Henriques to try and turn the tide. The squad has eight players confirmed out, including Camutanga, Riccieli, Edu, Gui, Nathan Mendes, and Dudu, in addition to the suspended Cacá. The betting market places a home win at 1.50, reflecting bettors' preference for the local side.

Casa Pia searching for first win

Casa Pia, under the guidance of Filipe Coelho, heads into Guimarães with four defeats and zero goals scored. The manager highlighted the need to capitalize on the attacking play showcased in their previous match against Moreirense, despite a 1-0 loss. Coelho emphasizes that "the time for goals and points will come" and that the team must make the most of the atmosphere in Guimarães to demonstrate their finishing ability.

Signings and updates

Vitória secured the signing of forward Mohamed Salah, who is already available to play, while center-back Felipe Silva, on loan from Porto, will still wait to join the squad. At Casa Pia, Belgian forward Mohamed Salah and center-back Felipe Silva are new additions who have yet to gain playing time for the club.

Betting market and statistics

The odds for the final result are 1.50 for Vitória de Guimarães, 4.10 for a draw, and 6.50 for a Casa Pia victory. The goals market lists over/under 2.5 at 1.91 and 1.83, respectively, while both teams to score bets carry odds of 2.17 or 9.75. The recent head-to-head record favors Casa Pia, who won their last encounter on May 11, 2026, by 1-0.

Match expectations

With both sides mired in an attacking crisis—Vitória with three goals in four matches and Casa Pia yet to find the net—the duel promises to be tense. The match could be decisive for Vitória, which needs points to steer clear of the relegation zone, and for Casa Pia, aiming to snap its losing streak and score its first goal of the season.

With information from NETVASCO, A Bola.
